objective: Add the three C1 endpoint handlers to app/api.py (amending the existing module; handle_export_csv stays intact): POST /reports/{report_id}/export-pdf -> 202 {job_id}; GET /jobs/{job_id} -> 200 C2 status shape; GET /jobs/{job_id}/download -> 200 raw PDF bytes / 409 not-done / 404 unknown, validating report existence via app/queries.py and lang against {en,de}, with unit tests against a stub JobStore.

concepts: framework-agnostic handler convention (path_params dict, body dict) -> (status_code, payload_dict) used by the existing handle_export_csv
status code discipline: 404 not-found, 400 bad input, 409 premature download

inputs: frozen contract C2 (JobStore API, consumed as a frozen stub)
app/api.py (existing pattern, handle_export_csv must stay intact)
app/queries.py (report existence check + customer id, read-only)
app/models.py (read-only, one hop from app/queries.py per the snapshot import graph — data shape only)

frozen_contracts.spec: POST /reports/{id}/export-pdf body {lang?: 'en'|'de'} -> 202 {job_id}; 404 {error} for unknown report; 400 {error} for lang not in {en,de}. GET /jobs/{job_id} -> 200 {job_id, status: 'queued'|'running'|'done'|'failed', created_at: int, error: string|null}; 404 {error} for unknown job. GET /jobs/{job_id}/download -> 200 with the raw PDF bytes as the response body (the bytes start with b'%PDF'; content-type application/pdf) when status is done; 409 {error: 'job not done'} while status is queued or running; 404 {error} for unknown job.

job record shape: {job_id: 'j<n>', report_id: string, customer_id: string, lang: 'en'|'de', status: 'queued'|'running'|'done'|'failed', created_at: int epoch, error: string|null, pdf_ref: string|null}. JobStore API: create(customer_id, report_id, lang) -> job_id; get(job_id) -> record|None; mark_running(job_id); mark_done(job_id, pdf_ref); mark_failed(job_id, error); next_queued() -> job_id|None.

non_goals: no changes to handle_export_csv behavior or its response shape
no importing app/jobs.py in code or tests (stub the JobStore per C2)
no PDF rendering or worker code
no email/notification of any kind (out of scope A)
implementation_constraints: handler signatures follow the existing convention in app/api.py
the JobStore is injected: handlers take a store parameter (default None -> tests pass a stub); the wiring of the real store is T06's job
missing lang key defaults to 'en'; lang outside {en,de} -> 400
unknown report -> 404 BEFORE any JobStore.create call (assert in the stub)

acceptance_tests.description: POST export-pdf for report r1 (known) with stub store -> 202, body {job_id} matching the stub's create return value; the stub create call received (customer_id from queries, report_id, lang 'en' by default)
POST export-pdf for unknown report -> 404 {error} and the stub store's create was NOT called
POST with lang='fr' -> 400 {error}; lang='de' -> 202 and the stub store records lang 'de'
GET /jobs/j1 with stub returning a done record -> 200 with exactly the C2 fields {job_id, status, created_at, error} (no extra keys)
download while status 'running' -> 409 {error: 'job not done'}; unknown job on poll and download -> 404

failure_cases.expected_behavior: missing lang defaults to 'en'; the handler returns 202

failure_cases.scenario: report exists but has zero rows
failure_cases.expected_behavior: enqueue returns 202; the renderer draws a title-only page (per T03 AT04); LookupError applies only to a customer with zero reports

handoff.notes: tests import a StubStore implementing the C2 method set — if C2's method set changed during the run, this package is stale (STALE_CONTRACT_SNAPSHOT will flag it).

warnings.detail: app/api.py is an existing shared file; the CSV handler must stay byte-compatible in behavior
warnings.rationale: acceptance A4 requires the existing suite to stay green
